import Mathlib

inductive Node
| mk (val : Int) (is_end : Bool) (left mid right : Option Node)
deriving Inhabited

namespace Node

def val (t : Node) : Int :=
  match t with | Node.mk v _ _ _ _ => v

def is_end (t : Node) : Bool :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ b _ _ _ => b

def left (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ l _ _ => l

def mid (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ m _ => m

def right (t : Node) : Option Node :=
  match t with | Node.mk _ _ _ _ r => r

end Node

def view (t : Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  let l := match t.left with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let r := match t.right with | some child => view child | none => ∅
  let m := match t.mid with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => t.val :: s) | none => ∅
  let current := if t.is_end then {[t.val]} else ∅
  l ∪ r ∪ m ∪ current
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_empty_node (t : Node) : Bool :=
  !t.is_end ∧ t.left.isNone ∧ t.mid.isNone ∧ t.right.isNone

def well_formed (t : Node) : Prop :=
  (0 ≤ t.val ∧ t.val < 256) ∧
  -- Check Left
  (match t.left with 
   | some l => 
       well_formed l ∧ 
       !is_empty_node l ∧ -- CRITICAL: Match Dafny pruning
       (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c < t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Right
  (match t.right with 
   | some r => 
       well_formed r ∧ 
       !is_empty_node r ∧ -- CRITICAL
       (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c::_ => c > t.val) 
   | none => True) ∧
  -- Check Mid
  (match t.mid with 
   | some m => 
       well_formed m ∧ 
       !is_empty_node m -- CRITICAL
   | none => True)
termination_by sizeOf t
decreasing_by all_goals sorry

def is_valid_key (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ k ∈ key, 0 ≤ k ∧ k < 256

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_precond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  (match t with
   | some node => well_formed node ∧ !is_empty_node node
   | none => True) ∧
  is_valid_key key ∧ -- Match Dafny byte constraint
  key.length > 0     -- Match Dafny non-empty constraint
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

def make_chain : List Int → Node
| [] => Node.mk 0 false none none none
| c :: [] => Node.mk c true none none none
| c :: d :: ds => Node.mk c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none

def insertCore : Option Node → List Int → Node
| none, key => make_chain key
| some n, [] => n
| some (Node.mk v b l m r), c :: cs =>
    if c < v then
      Node.mk v b (some (insertCore l (c :: cs))) m r
    else if v < c then
      Node.mk v b l m (some (insertCore r (c :: cs)))
    else
      match cs with
      | [] => Node.mk v true l m r
      | _ => Node.mk v b l (some (insertCore m cs)) r
termination_by t key => sizeOf t
decreasing_by
  all_goals simp_wf
  all_goals omega

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def insert (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) : Node :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  insertCore t key
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- View wrapper for Option Node
def view_opt (t : Option Node) : Set (List Int) :=
  match t with
  | some node => view node
  | none => ∅

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def insert_postcond (t : Option Node) (key : List Int) (result : Node)
    (_ : insert_precond t key) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  well_formed result ∧
  !is_empty_node result ∧
  view result = view_opt t ∪ {key}
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

lemma wf_mk_iff (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) ↔
      (0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256) ∧
      (match l with
       | some l =>
           well_formed l ∧
           !is_empty_node l ∧
           (∀ s ∈ view l, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c < v)
       | none => True) ∧
      (match r with
       | some r =>
           well_formed r ∧
           !is_empty_node r ∧
           (∀ s ∈ view r, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c > v)
       | none => True) ∧
      (match m with
       | some m => well_formed m ∧ !is_empty_node m
       | none => True) := by
  rw [well_formed.eq_1]
  simp only [Node.val, Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid]

lemma view_mk (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v b l m r) =
      (match l with | some child => view child | none => ∅) ∪
      (match r with | some child => view child | none => ∅) ∪
      (match m with | some child => (view child).image (fun s => v :: s) | none => ∅) ∪
      (if b then {[v]} else ∅) := by
  rw [view.eq_1]
  simp only [Node.left, Node.right, Node.mid, Node.val, Node.is_end]

lemma valid_key_tail {c : Int} {cs : List Int} :
    is_valid_key (c :: cs) → is_valid_key cs := by
  intro h x hx
  exact h x (by simp [hx])

lemma not_empty_left (v : Int) (b : Bool) (child : Node) (m r : Option Node) :
    !is_empty_node (Node.mk v b (some child) m r) := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

lemma not_empty_right (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m : Option Node) (child : Node) :
    !is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m (some child)) := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

lemma not_empty_mid (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l : Option Node) (child : Node) (r : Option Node) :
    !is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l (some child) r) := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

lemma not_empty_end (v : Int) (l m r : Option Node) :
    !is_empty_node (Node.mk v true l m r) := by
  simp [is_empty_node, Node.is_end, Node.left, Node.mid, Node.right]

lemma wf_left_order {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt l, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c < v := by
  have hp := (wf_mk_iff v b l m r).mp h
  intro s hs
  cases l with
  | none =>
      simp [view_opt] at hs
  | some node =>
      exact hp.2.1.2.2 s hs

lemma wf_right_order {v : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r)) :
    ∀ s ∈ view_opt r, match s with | [] => False | c :: _ => c > v := by
  have hp := (wf_mk_iff v b l m r).mp h
  intro s hs
  cases r with
  | none =>
      simp [view_opt] at hs
  | some node =>
      exact hp.2.2.1.2.2 s hs

lemma insertCore_none_eq (key : List Int) :
    insertCore none key = make_chain key := by
  rw [insertCore]

lemma insertCore_left_eq {v c : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node} {cs : List Int}
    (h : c < v) :
    insertCore (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: cs) =
      Node.mk v b (some (insertCore l (c :: cs))) m r := by
  cases cs with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertCore, h]
  | cons d ds =>
      simp [insertCore, h]

lemma insertCore_right_eq {v c : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node} {cs : List Int}
    (h₁ : ¬ c < v) (h₂ : v < c) :
    insertCore (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: cs) =
      Node.mk v b l m (some (insertCore r (c :: cs))) := by
  cases cs with
  | nil =>
      simp [insertCore, h₁, h₂]
  | cons d ds =>
      simp [insertCore, h₁, h₂]

lemma insertCore_end_eq {v c : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node}
    (h₁ : ¬ c < v) (h₂ : ¬ v < c) :
    insertCore (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) [c] =
      Node.mk v true l m r := by
  simp [insertCore, h₁, h₂]

lemma insertCore_mid_eq {v c d : Int} {b : Bool} {l m r : Option Node} {ds : List Int}
    (h₁ : ¬ c < v) (h₂ : ¬ v < c) :
    insertCore (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) (c :: d :: ds) =
      Node.mk v b l (some (insertCore m (d :: ds))) r := by
  simp [insertCore, h₁, h₂]

lemma view_left_update (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (new : Node) (key : List Int)
    (hnew : view new = view_opt l ∪ {key}) :
    view (Node.mk v b (some new) m r) =
      view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {key} := by
  ext s
  cases l <;>
    simp only [view_mk, view_opt, hnew, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      Set.mem_empty_iff_false] <;>
    aesop

lemma view_right_update (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (new : Node) (key : List Int)
    (hnew : view new = view_opt r ∪ {key}) :
    view (Node.mk v b l m (some new)) =
      view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {key} := by
  ext s
  cases r <;>
    simp only [view_mk, view_opt, hnew, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      Set.mem_empty_iff_false] <;>
    aesop

lemma view_mid_update (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node)
    (new : Node) (key : List Int)
    (hnew : view new = view_opt m ∪ {key}) :
    view (Node.mk v b l (some new) r) =
      view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {v :: key} := by
  ext s
  cases m <;>
    simp only [view_mk, view_opt, hnew, Set.image_union, Set.mem_union,
      Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_empty_iff_false, Set.mem_image] <;>
    aesop

lemma view_end_update (v : Int) (b : Bool) (l m r : Option Node) :
    view (Node.mk v true l m r) =
      view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {[v]} := by
  ext s
  cases b <;>
    simp only [view_mk, view_opt, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
      Set.mem_empty_iff_false, Bool.false_eq_true, Bool.true_eq_false, ↓reduceIte] <;>
    aesop

lemma make_chain_correct :
    ∀ key : List Int,
      is_valid_key key →
      key.length > 0 →
      well_formed (make_chain key) ∧
      !is_empty_node (make_chain key) ∧
      view (make_chain key) = {key}
| [], _hvalid, hlen => by
    simp at hlen
| c :: [], hvalid, _hlen => by
    have hc : 0 ≤ c ∧ c < 256 := hvalid c (by simp)
    have hwf : well_formed (Node.mk c true none none none) := by
      exact (wf_mk_iff c true none none none).mpr ⟨hc, trivial, trivial, trivial⟩
    have hne : !is_empty_node (Node.mk c true none none none) :=
      not_empty_end c none none none
    have hv : view (Node.mk c true none none none) = {[c]} := by
      ext s
      simp only [view_mk, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        Set.mem_empty_iff_false, ↓reduceIte]
      tauto
    change
      well_formed (Node.mk c true none none none) ∧
      !is_empty_node (Node.mk c true none none none) ∧
      view (Node.mk c true none none none) = {[c]}
    exact ⟨hwf, hne, hv⟩
| c :: d :: ds, hvalid, _hlen => by
    have hc : 0 ≤ c ∧ c < 256 := hvalid c (by simp)
    have htailValid : is_valid_key (d :: ds) := valid_key_tail hvalid
    have ih := make_chain_correct (d :: ds) htailValid (by simp)
    have hwf : well_formed (Node.mk c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none) := by
      exact (wf_mk_iff c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none).mpr
        ⟨hc, trivial, trivial, ⟨ih.1, ih.2.1⟩⟩
    have hne : !is_empty_node (Node.mk c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none) :=
      not_empty_mid c false none (make_chain (d :: ds)) none
    have hv :
        view (Node.mk c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none) =
          {c :: d :: ds} := by
      ext s
      simp only [view_mk, ih.2.2, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff,
        Set.mem_empty_iff_false, Set.mem_image, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
      aesop
    change
      well_formed (Node.mk c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none) ∧
      !is_empty_node (Node.mk c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none) ∧
      view (Node.mk c false none (some (make_chain (d :: ds))) none) = {c :: d :: ds}
    exact ⟨hwf, hne, hv⟩

def insertCore_correct :
    ∀ (t : Option Node) (key : List Int),
      insert_precond t key →
      well_formed (insertCore t key) ∧
      !is_empty_node (insertCore t key) ∧
      view (insertCore t key) = view_opt t ∪ {key}
| none, key, hpre => by
    cases key with
    | nil =>
        have hlen := hpre.2.2
        simp at hlen
    | cons c cs =>
        rw [insertCore_none_eq]
        simpa [view_opt] using make_chain_correct (c :: cs) hpre.2.1 (by simp)
| some (Node.mk v b l m r), [], hpre => by
    have hlen := hpre.2.2
    simp at hlen
| some (Node.mk v b l m r), c :: cs, hpre => by
    have hwf : well_formed (Node.mk v b l m r) := hpre.1.1
    have hvalid : is_valid_key (c :: cs) := hpre.2.1
    have hp := (wf_mk_iff v b l m r).mp hwf
    have hvbyte : 0 ≤ v ∧ v < 256 := hp.1
    have hleftFull := hp.2.1
    have hrightFull := hp.2.2.1
    have hmidFull := hp.2.2.2
    by_cases hlt : c < v
    · have hpreL : insert_precond l (c :: cs) := by
        refine ⟨?_, hvalid, by simp⟩
        cases l with
        | none =>
            trivial
        | some node =>
            exact ⟨hleftFull.1, hleftFull.2.1⟩
      have ih := insertCore_correct l (c :: cs) hpreL
      have horderNew :
          ∀ s ∈ view (insertCore l (c :: cs)),
            match s with | [] => False | x :: _ => x < v := by
        intro s hs
        have hs' : s ∈ view_opt l ∪ ({c :: cs} : Set (List Int)) := by
          rw [← ih.2.2]
          exact hs
        rcases hs' with hold | hnew
        · exact wf_left_order hwf s hold
        · simp at hnew
          subst s
          simpa using hlt
      have hwfRes :
          well_formed (Node.mk v b (some (insertCore l (c :: cs))) m r) := by
        exact (wf_mk_iff v b (some (insertCore l (c :: cs))) m r).mpr
          ⟨hvbyte, ⟨ih.1, ih.2.1, horderNew⟩, hrightFull, hmidFull⟩
      have hneRes :
          !is_empty_node (Node.mk v b (some (insertCore l (c :: cs))) m r) :=
        not_empty_left v b (insertCore l (c :: cs)) m r
      have hviewRes :
          view (Node.mk v b (some (insertCore l (c :: cs))) m r) =
            view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {c :: cs} :=
        view_left_update v b l m r (insertCore l (c :: cs)) (c :: cs) ih.2.2
      rw [insertCore_left_eq hlt]
      exact ⟨hwfRes, hneRes, hviewRes⟩
    · by_cases hgt : v < c
      · have hpreR : insert_precond r (c :: cs) := by
          refine ⟨?_, hvalid, by simp⟩
          cases r with
          | none =>
              trivial
          | some node =>
              exact ⟨hrightFull.1, hrightFull.2.1⟩
        have ih := insertCore_correct r (c :: cs) hpreR
        have horderNew :
            ∀ s ∈ view (insertCore r (c :: cs)),
              match s with | [] => False | x :: _ => x > v := by
          intro s hs
          have hs' : s ∈ view_opt r ∪ ({c :: cs} : Set (List Int)) := by
            rw [← ih.2.2]
            exact hs
          rcases hs' with hold | hnew
          · exact wf_right_order hwf s hold
          · simp at hnew
            subst s
            simpa [gt_iff_lt] using hgt
        have hwfRes :
            well_formed (Node.mk v b l m (some (insertCore r (c :: cs)))) := by
          exact (wf_mk_iff v b l m (some (insertCore r (c :: cs)))).mpr
            ⟨hvbyte, hleftFull, ⟨ih.1, ih.2.1, horderNew⟩, hmidFull⟩
        have hneRes :
            !is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l m (some (insertCore r (c :: cs)))) :=
          not_empty_right v b l m (insertCore r (c :: cs))
        have hviewRes :
            view (Node.mk v b l m (some (insertCore r (c :: cs)))) =
              view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {c :: cs} :=
          view_right_update v b l m r (insertCore r (c :: cs)) (c :: cs) ih.2.2
        rw [insertCore_right_eq hlt hgt]
        exact ⟨hwfRes, hneRes, hviewRes⟩
      · have hcv : c = v := by omega
        subst c
        cases cs with
        | nil =>
            have hwfRes : well_formed (Node.mk v true l m r) := by
              exact (wf_mk_iff v true l m r).mpr
                ⟨hvbyte, hleftFull, hrightFull, hmidFull⟩
            have hneRes : !is_empty_node (Node.mk v true l m r) :=
              not_empty_end v l m r
            have hviewRes :
                view (Node.mk v true l m r) =
                  view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {[v]} :=
              view_end_update v b l m r
            rw [insertCore_end_eq hlt hgt]
            exact ⟨hwfRes, hneRes, hviewRes⟩
        | cons d ds =>
            have htailValid : is_valid_key (d :: ds) := valid_key_tail hvalid
            have hpreM : insert_precond m (d :: ds) := by
              refine ⟨?_, htailValid, by simp⟩
              cases m with
              | none =>
                  trivial
              | some node =>
                  exact ⟨hmidFull.1, hmidFull.2⟩
            have ih := insertCore_correct m (d :: ds) hpreM
            have hwfRes :
                well_formed (Node.mk v b l (some (insertCore m (d :: ds))) r) := by
              exact (wf_mk_iff v b l (some (insertCore m (d :: ds))) r).mpr
                ⟨hvbyte, hleftFull, hrightFull, ⟨ih.1, ih.2.1⟩⟩
            have hneRes :
                !is_empty_node (Node.mk v b l (some (insertCore m (d :: ds))) r) :=
              not_empty_mid v b l (insertCore m (d :: ds)) r
            have hviewRes :
                view (Node.mk v b l (some (insertCore m (d :: ds))) r) =
                  view_opt (some (Node.mk v b l m r)) ∪ {v :: d :: ds} :=
              view_mid_update v b l m r (insertCore m (d :: ds)) (d :: ds) ih.2.2
            rw [insertCore_mid_eq hlt hgt]
            exact ⟨hwfRes, hneRes, hviewRes⟩
termination_by t key _ => sizeOf t
decreasing_by
  all_goals simp_wf
  all_goals omega

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem insert_postcond_satisfied (t : Option Node) (key : List Int)
    (h_precond : insert_precond t key) :
    insert_postcond t key (insert t key h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  change
    well_formed (insertCore t key) ∧
    !is_empty_node (insertCore t key) ∧
    view (insertCore t key) = view_opt t ∪ {key}
  exact insertCore_correct t key h_precond
  -- !benchmark @end proof
